g.text: Where the Business Record Lives — Four Data Families, Four Intentional Rules
Everything else may refer to a customer,
but only here does a customer truly live.
A customer's addresses are always found
together on the same server — so a
and this family grows without limit.
Kept whole on purpose: splitting it
would add cost for no commercial gain.
Old months are set aside in full, then
Queries only ever examine what is
Grows forever; kept together by customer
Archive old periods; query only what matters
